proposals.title: Scope displacement-reversal tests to their actual continuation assumptions
proposals.claim: A negative cosine between consecutive population displacements does not by itself falsify autonomous state-dependent dynamics or every transport method; a synthetic counterexample can demonstrate the limitation before data arrive.
proposals.mechanism: Validation affects interpretation of mmd_u: forecast distribution errors may reflect mixture change or an incorrect constant-displacement assumption. Audit the statistic on curved autonomous flows and changing mixtures before using it as an architecture gate; no score gain is claimed.
proposals.falsifier: Try an autonomous rotational field sampled at three times and a fixed-state mixture with changing weights. Kill the audit claim if the exact proposed statistic cannot report reversal in either construction under declared sampling.

evidence.says: Persona asserts a stationarity experiment excludes four method families; named experiment files are absent from inspected inventory.
Neural ODE persona treats negative displacement cosine as field reversal; no underlying measurements are provided.
Uses time-varying fields and explicit energy, density, velocity and growth priors; these are more specific than constant centroid displacement.

proposals.title: Require distinct solver-convergence and temporal-generalization audits
proposals.claim: For a fixed trained dynamics model, solver convergence and later-time predictive validity are distinct checks; recording both prevents a numerically converged forecast being counted as biological validation.
proposals.mechanism: Record mmd_u and de_direction separately for interior versus future holdouts, plus prediction sensitivity to solver tolerance at fixed parameters. Numerical agreement tests integration error; held-out embryo metrics test marginal forecast utility, not lineage or growth. No improvement is asserted.
proposals.falsifier: Reject the protocol if it cannot separate fixed-parameter numerical sensitivity from held-out biological error, or if preprocessing/time splits use future information. Empirical execution awaits biological data.

evidence.says: Requests error versus temporal distance and testing recursive accumulation of biological errors.
Distinguishes random-split success, temporal holdout, interpolation and extrapolation.

evidence.ref: Chen et al., Neural Ordinary Differential Equations, 2018 preprint, arXiv:1806.07366, https://arxiv.org/abs/1806.07366
evidence.says: Outputs use a differential equation solver with a numerical precision/speed tradeoff; this is an architectural property.

peer_responses.on: Actual devbio question: do mmd_u/de_direction justify only marginals, with tracing and growth/death evidence needed for fate claims?
peer_responses.because: Yes: endpoint marginals cannot identify couplings or growth laws. Refined r1-2 to marginal forecast utility. Resolving test: withheld progenitor-conditioned clones plus independent growth/death, with embryo-level uncertainty; no biological results exist.

declined: Declined a large Neural ODE trained immediately from sparse marginals, and blanket rejection of all flow methods from an absent cosine test. Neither a regularized fitted flow nor missing historical evidence establishes biological dynamics or model superiority.
